name: @qf-jarvis/jarvis-runtime
description: QF Jarvis orchestrated reply composition foundation (QFJ-M5). One pre-transport composition root that wires the merged M1 runtime, M2 orchestration, M3 Core decision adapter, and M4 model reply adapter into a deterministic, fail-closed, async end-to-end flow (inbound -> model draft -> PENDING_CORE_VALIDATION proposal -> Core decision) behind ONE authoritative content-free async conversation-state source that every lower state reader delegates to (no split-brain). It duplicates no business rule and performs no delivery, persistence, or live call. Model output is a draft/proposal input only, never a Core ACCEPTED, never sent/delivered/executed/persisted; QuickFurno Core remains the only business authority. Depends on @qf-jarvis/agent-runtime, @qf-jarvis/core-decision-adapter, and @qf-jarvis/model-reply-adapter.
